scenes.tekst: Will your print fall over? Check it in Blender before you print.
scenes.label: QUICK CHECK

scenes.tekst: Open Object, Set Origin, Origin to Center of Mass, Volume.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: Now look from the front. View, Viewpoint, Front.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: The orange dot is the balance point. It sits outside the foot, so this tips over.
scenes.label: WHY

scenes.tekst: To fix it, press Tab, then 3. From below, click the bottom face.
scenes.uitspraak: To fix it, press Tab, then three. From below, click the bottom face.
scenes.label: STEP 3

scenes.tekst: Press S, type 3, Enter. The foot is now three times wider.
scenes.uitspraak: Press S, type three, Enter. The foot is now three times wider.
scenes.label: STEP 4

scenes.tekst: Set the origin again. The dot is now inside the foot.
scenes.label: RESULT

scenes.tekst: A wider foot or less lean keeps your print standing.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: HONEST
